layout_and_spacing.padding_philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-6, p-8, p-12). Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6/p-8) to prevent text collision.

navigation.mobile_dock: Bottom sticky bar for marketplace search / checkout action on small screens (data-testid='mobile-dock')

features: City / Neighborhood filter (São Paulo, Rio, Curitiba, Belo Horizonte)
Field type tags (Society 7v7, Futsal Indoor, Campo Aberto 11v11, Saibro/Grama Sintética)

steps: Step 1: Choose Field & Specific Court/Pitch (Select Society 1 vs Society 2)
Step 2: Interactive Real-time Weekly Slot Grid (Select Date + Time Slot e.g., 19:00 - 20:00 R$180)
Step 3: Pay/Confirm Checkout (PIX QR Code simulation, Stripe Credit Card simulation, Deposit vs Full Pay)
three_step_booking.ux_patterns: iFood / Booking.com style summary sidebar with sticky 'Confirmar Reserva' CTA button, countdown timer for hold slot (10 mins), and instant toast confirmation via Sonner.

features: Weekly / Daily Agenda Grid with quick manual block ('Bloquear Horário')
Fields & Pricing CRUD (hourly rate, peak hours pricing e.g. after 18h)
Revenue & Bookings Panel (R$ Total Month, Occupancy Rate %, PIX vs Card breakdown)
Subscription status badge ('Plano Pro - 7 dias de teste grátis / 7 days free trial' with 'Assinar no Stripe' CTA button)
Owner Management Table (Activate / Deactivate owners, view subscription status)
Platform Metrics (Total Revenue, Active Owners, Total Bookings, MRR)
Quick demo login switchers ('Entrar como Jogador', 'Entrar como Dono de Arena', 'Entrar como Admin')

instructions_to_main_agent: ALWAYS include `data-testid` attributes on every single button, select, input, modal trigger, card, tab, and status indicator.
Use standard React .js and .jsx files with Tailwind CSS and Shadcn/ui primitives already present in `src/components/ui/`.
Ensure bilingual PT-BR (default) / EN text switch works seamlessly across all roles (Marketplace, Customer Bookings, Owner Dashboard, Admin Dashboard).
In the 3-step booking flow, make time slots interactive, visually crisp, and display price per slot (e.g. '19:00 - 20:00 | R$ 180').
Owner dashboard must feature a 7-day trial banner ('7 dias grátis restantes') with Stripe subscription button simulation.
Use `sonner` (`toast.success`, `toast.error`) for all booking confirmations, slot locks, cancellations, and field CRUD operations.
Avoid full transparent headers; use `backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80` with border.
Include quick role-switch pills in the header so reviewers can effortlessly jump between Customer Marketplace, Field Owner Portal, and Platform Admin Console.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case format.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.spacing: Use 2-3x generous spacing. Avoid cramped tables or tiny touch targets on mobile.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.micro_interactions: Hover scaling (hover:scale-[1.02]), crisp active button states (active:scale-95), and active tab highlighting.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.contrast: Ensure white text over dark backgrounds or dark text over emerald badges meets WCAG AA standards.
